# Oh Your Ear

> Ear training in the browser: single notes, intervals, chords, melody and rhythm — in Chinese and English, in light and dark.

For anyone who wants to train their ear: instrumentalists, sight-singing students, curious hobbyists. Guests can practise every basic exercise with no account; signing in adds saved progress, a mistake notebook, a practice streak and achievements.

## Practice modules

- Single notes: hear one note and name it
- Intervals: hear the distance between two notes
- Chords: hear the quality of a chord
- Melody: hear a phrase and play it back
- Rhythm: hear a pattern and tap it

## Pages

- [Landing page](https://ohyourear.com/): what the product is and how to start
- [Start practising](https://app.ohyourear.com/): the practice hub (the app interface, not indexed)

## Facts

- Pure web app, nothing to install; audio is Tone.js over Salamander piano samples
- Answers are graded in the browser; signing in syncs them to the server
- Free; no ads, no data sold
